method: Separate headless Chromium instances and profiles; held thrust, periodic steering, drill and light enabled; exact deployed JavaScript plus observation wrappers. Comparison changes only each browser response; no deployment.
limitations: No production authentication: fly status could not run, so server bufferedAmount was not observed.
The first run recorded a 2.93-second snapshot application plateau plus a separate delayed stream reaching 9.3 seconds behind; not every user freeze is proven to share one cause.
Client-only A/B variants are browser response overrides; server patches were assessed against observed packets and existing input logic, not deployed.
